_doc: Design roles derived from the CucoStudio style. scripts/style_brief.py --apply fills style_id/name/size/palette/fonts; YOU assign roles after LOOKING at the style's poster sheet: paper (the stock / frame background), ink (lines + type), gold (highlight blocks under key words), accent, tint (light fill), accent2 (deep fill), muted (secondary type). kinds = per-modality inks {text,image,video,audio}. print = the press feel: wobble (edge displacement px, 0 = clean vector), grain (paper grain opacity), speck (ink dropouts 0..1), mis (misregistration scale, 0 = registered). Defaults = style 65 'Cuco'.
